Bangladesh

  1. Meet your representative
  2. Find an agent

Why choose UEL?

  • Affordable London experience: Tuition fees and accommodation costs are lower than at many UK universities, with scholarships available on most courses.
  • Traditional campus, urban access: Study in East London on a close-knit campus, with direct Tube links to central London in around 35 minutes.
  • Careers-first learning: Our courses combine academic study with real-world experience, including work placements where available.
  • Placement year options: Selected postgraduate courses include a placement year to help build practical experience and employability.
  • Top-ranked student experience: Ranked #1 in London for student experience in the National Student Survey (NSS) 2024.
  • Recognised teaching quality: Named University of the Year for Teaching Quality in the Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2025.
How to apply
Find the course that's right for you:

Entry requirements

Undergraduate

  • Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) and a recognised International Foundation course or equivalent
  • Exceptional students with a GPA of 4.5 in HSC / Intermediate Certificate (or First Class under the previous grading system) and high grades in Secondary School Certificate (SSC)
  • Diploma (from the Bangladesh Technical Education Board) with an overall CGPA of at least 3.0 (out of 4) or 65 per cent plus

Postgraduate

  • A 3-year or 4-year bachelor’s (Hons) degree with at least a second division/class or CGPA 2.75 out of 4.0
  • A master’s degree with a minimum second class/division or CGPA 2.75 out of 4.0
Contact us

Accepted English Language Qualifications

  • IELTS
  • TOEFL IBT
  • Pearson Test of English (PTE)
  • Oxford International English Test (OIETC)

Learn more about accepted English Language Qualifications

English language requirements

To study at UEL you must demonstrate that your English level is at the standard for university study. We accept a number of different English language qualifications/tests for entry onto our courses, with IELTS being the most common.

Meet your representative

Nitin Bhasson

About: Nitin Bhasson is the Territory Manager for South Asia at the University of East London, bringing over two decades of experience in international education. A UK-certified industry expert, he leads strategic partnerships, recruitment growth, and stakeholder engagement across the region, driving student success through ethical and data-driven recruitment practices.

Shape your future at UEL

At the University of East London, we don’t just award degrees - we launch careers. Every programme is designed with the future in mind, blending academic learning with hands on experience through placements with leading industry partners.
As we look ahead, our commitment is stronger than ever - helping you build the skills, connections, and confidence to succeed on a global stage.
